target_customer: Developers building multiplayer AI products, software factories and agent coordination systems that need durable per-entity state
problem: Agents and multiplayer apps need persistent, serialized state without a shared database scramble. Terse offers Durable Actors, stateful serverless actors each with its own SQLite database and WebSocket server.
business_model: Open source runtime (MIT) with a managed cloud, usage based
product_category: Stateful serverless infrastructure for AI agents

founders.name: Thomas Elias Karatzas
prior_employers: Apple (Staff Engineer, 7 years, Siri and Apple Intelligence)

founders.name: Olivier Simard-Morissette
founders.background_notes: The YC launch post says the founders met at McGill; his own degree is not listed.

competitors.name: Cloudflare Durable Objects
competitors.what: Stateful serverless objects with co-located storage

competitors.name: Rivet Actors
competitors.what: Open source, Apache licensed alternative to Durable Objects, with a cloud and self-host option

technical_complexity.rationale: Co-located micro-VMs, per-actor SQLite, streaming writes to object storage and dormancy with S3 backup require deep distributed systems work from a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: The runtime is MIT licensed and Rivet already offers an open source alternative; lock-in would come from hosted usage rather than the code.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet observable; Cloudflare owns the category being cloned and Rivet shipped actor features in 2025.

market_need_then: Agent and multiplayer workloads need per-entity state and serialization. Several vendors (Rivet, Telnyx stateful actors, Restate) shipped durable actor or execution products in 2025 and 2026, suggesting demand.

branding.domain_note: Company uses useterse.ai because it uses a use prefix; the plain name is not used.

identity.voice_and_tone: Terse, developer focused product pages built around CLI commands

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt listing and a Fondo blog post in October 2026 cover the launch.

brand_strength.rationale: Short memorable word that fits a minimal developer tool, but a different Terse Inc. also exists in aggregator data and the brand has no community traction yet.

outcome_analysis: Terse is a two person Fall 2026 company that launched Durable Actors in late 2026 as an open source alternative to Cloudflare Durable Objects. Founders have strong engineering resumes from Apple, Squarespace and a prior acquired startup. No funding or outcome events are public yet, so the story is early; the main risk is a crowded actor runtime niche.
notes: Unverified: Dealroom lists a 125K USD seed for a Terse Inc. in New York described as background agents in closed alpha; it is unclear whether this is the same company, so it is not recorded as a round. Competitors are dated by Rivet's October 2025 post. No outcome news found. Name origin not found.
